turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on comparatives (-er, more ... than)?
turns.tutor:
Look: a cat is small. A mouse is smaller than a cat. I add -er to small, and then I write than.
The rule is: add -er to a short describing word, then write than before the second thing.
Right: A mouse is smaller than a cat. Wrong: A mouse is more small than a cat.
Now you try. Complete: "Cairo is ___ (big) than Luxor."
